newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper futures called to open firmer.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper futures called to open firmer.

text.p: COMEX copper futures were called to open firmer Thursday as LME three months copper broke through the key $2,440 per tonne level to reach its highest in 11-1/2 months.
LME stocks fell 3,225 tonnes Thursday to 146,075 tonnes.
July COMEX copper was called 1.10 to 1.40 cents higher after trading between 115.00 an 113.70 cents a lb on ACCESS.
The fund-led rally on LME overnight came amid concerns over Chilean production which may face some labor unrest, and a further sharp drawdown in London exchange stocks.
COMEX stocks on Wednesday fell 1,319 short tons to 39,160 short tons.
Wednesday, Merrill Lynch said July COMEX copper was poised to reach 117.00 to 118.00 cents.
